    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    CODEX is built on the conviction that software fluency is a strategic capability — not a technical footnote. Every module pairs business-English precision with engineering judgment, architectural literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium software leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern software development — from the foundations of programming and web development to AI-powered coding tools and cloud-native architecture.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — code reviews, sprint planning, production incidents, architecture decisions — written for international software professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. CODEX reflects his vision: software fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and engineering credibility.

    Designed for the developers, tech leads, and engineering leaders shaping how the world builds software — CODEX is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for turning an idea into working code.
